get_config_from_yaml: get a habitat_baselines config object from a YAML file with optional overrides
get_config_with_overrides: get a config object composed of a YAML file and override list like trainer_name=ddppo
get_config_custom_dir: get a config object using a custom configs_dir path instead of the default baselines directory
register_hydra_plugin: register the HabitatBaselinesConfigPlugin with Hydra for structured config support
review_get_config: review the get_config function to understand how it composes YAML configs with overrides
